changes.shows: The o bowl contains a separate low comma head and hooked descending tail. The next n is ordinary.

The first cell has a p descender and an a lower bowl; the second contains the r upright/shoulder and two v arms. These are overlapping cells, not an extra sequential v. The following accented é and sumée are legible.

A straight left stem and upper/lower serif traces coexist with a curved G body and inward return. An E/G overprint is favored, while repeated G and single-letter alternatives remain qualified. This is not inferred from the functor name.

A hand line rises after the first paragraph-11 comma, runs beneath the added typed sentence and curls at its right. The underline directly beneath 1 is distinct and retained.
The second cell has an o oval with an r stem/foot, and the third has an r shoulder/stem and a complete low o curve. The physical overlapping letters are retained.

The second cell has a tall l stem and an additional low bowl with a right upright, favoring u/l overlap. A b-like body cannot be excluded. There is only one occupied cell between m and t, not H's two separate u/l cells.
Two g descender loops occupy adjacent positions. In the second position the acute accent and an e body overlap the g; néral follows. The first two cells cannot be reduced to a plain gé sequence.
A continuous blue line runs beneath the typed word.

Eight occupied positions are visible. The first two have p descenders and extra baseline-foot/shoulder traces favoring r/p overlaps; single or repeated p remain possible at the first, with the same selected reading used at the second. The next closed o-like body has u-like side/foot traces, and the a later in the word shares a cell with a q descender. The uncertain layers are not regularized to a grammatical word.
The final cell has both the long l ascender with top serif and a p bowl/descender; these occupy the same cell. C's letter choice is replaced by the visible overlap.

inspection_note: Root alone viewed the whole and both supplied halves before C/H, then checked every agreed word and sign and all differences in the ink. All 65 recorded crops were actually viewed; the truncated insertfoncs/fibrescancel/M2 batch was repeated individually, and slanted hand additions were rotated upright. All twelve C doubt loci were resolved or explicitly retained with reasons. The display, every category letter, k/End/unit, sign (-1)^ij, i/j, cancellations and all four insertion guides were enlarged. Unusual spellings symmétrie, canulée, débarassé and the visible factorisant ending were checked without grammatical correction. The right-edge e of catégorie is partly occluded but its bowl and crossbar remain identifiable. Dense de at a later line start has insufficient positive evidence for a second letter and remains plain; ordinary M letters likewise are not called repeated strikes on darkness alone. Archive pencil 124 stays a comment. No context, second-pass audit or mathematical checking has occurred.
